consequence.statement: UI YAML view rendering improvement; no operational consequence for an operator is stated.

original.statement: The Argo CD UI now splits arrays in YAML views to fix ambiguous collapse when array items have nested objects; no operator impact is stated.

decision.reason: [ev-392c5d206c38] lists this only as a UI feature: arrays in the YAML view are now split so that collapsing is no longer ambiguous when array items have nested objects. Nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured, needs migrating or behaves differently for workloads or configuration. It only changes how the UI displays YAML. So "none" (informational, low severity) fits, and "behavior-change" would overstate a display change.
